messages:
deploy-bot: Build failed for release v2.44 (commit abc123) — job=build-web@install-deps. exit_code=1

deploy-bot: Relevant log:
```
npm ERR! code ERESOLVE
npm ERR! unable to resolve dependency tree
node-gyp rebuild
error: Cannot find prebuilt binary for sharp for 'node-v105'
```

ashley: seeing this locally too. sharp falling back to source build (node-gyp) and failing in CI image

sam: we pulled the new baseimage yesterday which upgrades node from 18 -> 20 (buildpack v20). Could be compatibility issue

nate: deploy-bot metadata shows builder: heroku-buildpack-node@20.0.0 and baseimage node:20-alpine

ashley: sharp prebuilt binaries are only published for up-to-node18 on our pinned version. node20 triggers compile, and CI image doesn't have build-essential/python

jen: change window opens in 2h. Do we want to block the cut or try a quick patch?

sam: options: 1) pin baseimage to node:18 in Dockerfile and rerun CI; 2) install toolchain in CI images (longer); 3) upgrade sharp to a version with prebuilt for node20 (risky for regressions)

nate: prefer minimal surface right now — pin baseimage back to node18 for this release and follow up with infra work

ashley: I can make the Dockerfile PR and add installing build-essential + python fallback in the CI image if we need it later

release-manager: decision: HOLD cut. Patch: pin baseimage to node:18-alpine in web Dockerfile, run CI. If green, manual promote to staging artifacts and proceed with cut. If still fails after 30m, rollback to previous artifact and open rollback ticket.

jen: adding short note to release notes: "temporary pin baseimage to node18 due to sharp binary compatibility; follow-up to remove pin after infra fix"

sam: opening PR now: #4823 — Dockerfile: FROM node:18-alpine 

deploy-bot: CI: re-run queued job build-web #7421 (triggered by PR #4823)

ci-bot: build-web #7421 started (install-deps)

ashley: heads up: if it fails for missing make/gcc/python, I'll push a follow-up to add build-essential and python3 to the CI image. Trying to avoid that for this quick cut though

ci-bot: build-web #7421 failed at install-deps: gyp ERR! stack Error: Can't find Python executable "python2"

ashley: exact failure I feared. quick push to PR to apt-get install python3 make g++ (alpine: add build-base python3)

sam: updated PR, CI rerun requested

deploy-bot: build-web #7421 succeeded. artifact pushed to staging registry (sha: def456).

release-manager: unholding cut. proceeding with promotion during change window 14:00-16:00 UTC. I'll notify release channel with the note.

ashley: creating follow-up checklist: 1) add buildpack compatibility test to canary; 2) bake toolchain into CI images OR ensure packages with native deps have prebuilt binaries; 3) postmortem note in release doc

nate: +1. We'll track infra ticket INF-1297 for the long-term fix

sam: :thumbsup: thanks all for quick turnaround

release-manager: tagging this thread as resolved once release is cut.
